provenance.basis: Independent adaptation of protected generic Dig behavior, exact native952/830 definitions and1470 asset/source gamevals, Wiki tool context and existing held-action/protection/queue infrastructure. No donor source/configuration/assets copied.
restrictions: Root ISC does not establish blanket per-file or dependency clearance.
Private cache, protected source, Wiki/native fixtures and historical evidence remain local; only independent rules and source attestations are published.

registration_dispatch.role: Attest ordinary F2P native952 first Dig, animation830 and scoped absent-or1470 digspade alias; reject contradictions.
Install the checked ordinary spade configuration during actual startup.
Native first Dig button2 retains selected slot and claimed ID without duplicate-slot search.
Actual action dispatch enters authoritative selected held-action lifecycle handling.
Validate actor, selected ordinary tool and delay; select first registered claim, run pre-dig veto, revalidate and admit protected completion before animation/sound.
Content registration before admission exposes real claims/before/dig callbacks; no native quest/boss hook is fabricated.
Existing weak queue produces default completion or collects full-World hook callbacks after the actor loop.
Invoke the originally claimed callback on a still-valid actor, never generic fallback after a claimed action.

dependencies: ENV: selected native held-slot dispatch, ordinary item catalog, generational actor admission, existing protected Weak scheduler, inventory and normal animation/synth/chat projection.
expected_normal_behavior: Ordinary held spade952 first Dig is native button2. Validate the selected tool itself; another spade elsewhere does not satisfy a stale selected claim. A full backpack remains valid.

With no registered claim, emit animation830 and synth1470 immediately, wait two protected ticks, reset animation65535 and send normal chat: You dig a hole in the ground... but find nothing. Tool count, inventory, XP, coordinates and RNG remain unchanged.

With a registered claim, run its before callback first; veto produces no generic effects. After two ticks invoke that selected hook instead of the default message. Developer fixtures exercise actual callback execution, not native quest acceptance.
expected_negative_behavior: Reject stale actor/slot/item, stackable/dummy/noted/placeholder/transformed tool, count/vars changes, invalid delay/clock or dead/saving/logout/modal actor before generic effects. Revalidate live actor/tool after a pre-dig callback.

Held action and new location request remove the spade job; logout/dialogue-epoch mismatch and lifecycle invalidation suppress late fallback or hook completion. Accepted movement follows existing Weak cancellation.
Reject contradictory native symbol/operation bindings. Missing digspade alias alone is allowed only by scoped source1470/native-asset attestation; shared symbols/cache remain unchanged.
No unregistered X Marks the Spot or Barrows behavior, clue reward, quest stage, crypt teleport or old-man dialogue is implied by the hook interface.

fallback: You dig a hole in the ground... but find nothing.

timing: Generic source anim/sound -> delay2 -> reset -> default message or selected hook. Existing Weak job ages while protected but cannot launch until protection permits.
Ready hook callbacks are collected by the actor queue pass and run with mutable World after PlayerMain actor iteration. Exact source coroutine/phase order remains an independent V4 obligation.
transactions: Queue admission precedes generic effects; no inventory/tool consumption, XP, RNG, authoritative teleport or new player persistence field is introduced.
The configured hook registry is startup metadata; the existing per-player scheduler holds only selected hook identity and dialogue epoch. A hook owns its own content mutation/error behavior.

before is a synchronous host callback boundary, not a port of suspendable quest dialogue. Actual asynchronous hook consumers require separate content continuation implementations and independent tests.

required_verification_levels.reason: Exact ordinary952 first Dig/830 and source1470/native asset bindings, real startup and native selected-slot dispatch, executable compilation.

Full-pack/default exact two-tick behavior, reset/chat/sound and no item/XP/RNG/movement effects; actual claimed/vetoed developer callbacks, stale selected duplicates, catalog/vars/delay/lifecycle and cancellation.
Genuine native first Dig952, animation/synth/reset/chat visibility, full backpack and ordinary item persistence, source comparison; working-tree unit checks do not establish this.
Native held/movement/dialogue/logout/reconnect/death/save behavior around protected delay, no late completion/replay, no transient job persistence.
Pinned SpadeScript/SpadeModule/SpadeDigHook/quest gamevals plus Wiki Spade context; source tick/coroutine/phase order and asynchronous before hook consumers remain independent obligations.

known_limitations: Independent V0-V4/native/pristine/lifecycle/source acceptance remains pending; implementation-owner checks are development evidence only.
X Marks the Spot, Barrows and any Farming/Treasure Trails or other hook consumers are unported mandatory obligations. Only generic no-hook Dig is registered in native startup.

Source suspendable before/dig semantics are not implemented by a generic async engine; configured callbacks are synchronous and must use existing content continuations when actual consumers are ported.

No new origin/retained-tool completion check is invented. Preexisting walking follows host movement policy; accepted new movement clears Weak queues. Modal protection may defer a job rather than universally cancel it; a changed dialogue epoch suppresses completion. Exact source interruption policy needs V4.
Prepared synth.sym has no digspade alias. Source quest gamevals maps1470 and a native258-byte sound1470 exists; absence is scoped, contradictory mappings fail.

observed_in_source: SpadeScript binds selected first held spade operation, chooses the first claiming hook, allows beforeDig veto, animates human_dig, plays digspade, delays2, resets animation and either sends exact no-hook text or invokes dig.
SpadeModule binds the hook set; actual X Marks the Spot and Barrows consumers have separate quest/position/dialogue/reward/teleport behavior. Quest gamevals explicitly maps digspade1470.
wiki_supported: Pinned Spade revision15318128 supports F2P tool identity and Dig/general uses. It does not independently establish sound1470, animation830, delay2 or quest callback timing.
intentional_adaptations: Reuse selected native held action, existing protected Weak queue and animation/sound/chat events; ordinary startup config and real function-pointer hook registry avoid new player/persistence or global gameplay state.
Collect claimed completions for mutable World after actor iteration. Synthetic hooks are explicitly developer-only fixtures; native consumers are not registered or accepted.
inferred_or_unresolved: Independent native timing/scene/chat/synth and lifecycle/source comparison; actual async quest/boss/Farming/Treasure Trails consumers remain open.
